subject.title: fix(gateway): skip secrets.resolve when target SecretRefs use exec providers

question: Should OpenClaw accept active exec-backed command SecretRefs as a reason to skip gateway `secrets.resolve` and execute the existing local command-secret resolver before the gateway snapshot RPC?
rationale: The code shape is narrow and well-tested, but the behavior intentionally changes the credential execution boundary for active command targets when CLI and gateway environments can differ.

options.title: Accept active exec local resolution
options.body: Land the PR as the intended policy: active command targets that require exec providers bypass a guaranteed-failing gateway RPC and use the existing local resolver.

options.title: Require gateway-first rework
options.body: Ask for a design that preserves gateway snapshot resolution as the default and only suppresses the known noisy failure path without broadening the pre-RPC skip.

options.title: Pause for broader SecretRef direction
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers decide the broader cross-context exec SecretRef consistency direction tracked separately.

recommendation.title: Accept active exec local resolution
recommendation.body: Land the PR as the intended policy: active command targets that require exec providers bypass a guaranteed-failing gateway RPC and use the existing local resolver.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is assigned on the PR and has the strongest recent history on the command-secret/gateway secrets boundary.
